title: Autonomic onboard CI: event-triggered model build, timeboxed pinning & signature-led profile rollout
creator: Riley Chen
description: Build a resilient, event-driven CI workflow that automates model artifact builds, cryptographic signing, short-lived (timeboxed) version pin issuance, and conditional publishing of performance profiles. Goal is to reduce manual promotion steps and eliminate stale pins while preserving safety via gated rollouts and retractable signatures.
acceptance_criteria: New model PR triggers a reproducible build job that emits a signed artifact and a performance profile candidate
CI issues a timeboxed pin (TTL) for the artifact that can auto-retract after expiry if not promoted
Automated smoke and perf checks gate publishing the performance profile to the catalog; failures automatically mark pin for manual review
All artifacts and profile metadata are cosigned and logged to the provenance ledger with traceable links
Rollback path: ability to revoke pin and publish a replacement profile within 15 minutes of a detected regression
tech_notes: Use existing build container images from ENG-4729 for hermetic reproducibility
Integrate cosign attestations into the pipeline and publish attestation blob to S3 + ledger
Implement pin TTL via release-broker service: create pin with expiry metadata and optional auto-retract hook
Profile publication step requires combined pass of smoke tests (latency/throughput) and quality check (eval suite), each run in isolated Kubernetes ephemeral runners
Promote flow must sign a release descriptor and call model-catalog publish API guarded by a short-lived service token
rollout_plan: Phase 1: opt-in pilot for 3 internal models, non-production catalog only. Phase 2: extend to nightly builds for curated models with manual approval required for production pins. Phase 3: full automation for low-risk models with canary traffic and automatic fallback to pinned last-known-good.
monitoring: Create dashboards for build latency, attestation failures, pin expirations, profile regression alerts. Add a synthetic job that exercises published profile end-to-end and reports quality drift to Sentry and Console alerting channels.
risks: Automating promotion increases risk of publishing bad profiles; mitigations: strict eval thresholds, canary routing, and immediate pin revocation workflow. Key compromise risk if signing keys leaked; require HSM-protected keys and short-lived tokens for publish steps.
